Scores are maintained rubric measurements, not independent proof every deduction is factual. No score/rubric/golden tuning.
method: Viewed all30 original JPEGs as labeled lossless contact sheets plus direct original dialogueframes0/4; read all18 raw subject outputs and18 complete-source Opus reviews. Root independently corroborated dialogue geometry. Source/golden/scorer unchanged. No paid rejudge or favorable-score replacement.
taxonomy: Unsupported camera/emotion inference and continuity-label failure are contract/grounding misses, not automatically fabricated observable events. Tone, color naming, motion taxonomy and omitted keywords are separated from source errors. Empty definite_source_errors means no concrete fabricated source event identified in this bounded review, not a universal invention-free guarantee.
